title: Energy Level Diagram
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately sketch the energy levels for atomic Li and hydrogen for n = 2, 3, 4.

title: Absorption Lines
description: Important Criteria: The student should indicate the correct transitions for absorption lines from 2s to np states.

title: Emission Lines
description: Important Criteria: The student must indicate the emission lines corresponding to transitions between energy levels.

title: Labeling
description: Essential Criteria: The energy levels and transitions must be clearly labeled to indicate which are absorption and which are emission.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid mislabeling transitions or incorrectly representing energy levels.
